old: 1 Corinthians 5:7 — *Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Messiah (Christ) our passover is sacrificed for us:* The seven-day unleavened feast the exiles keep before Yahuah in 1 Esdras 7:14 finds its substance in Yahusha, our Passover.
new: 1 Esdras 7:14 — *they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before Yahuah (God).* Messiah (Christ) our Passover is the reason the feast is kept, not the end of it (1 Corinthians 5:7).

old: Isaiah 6:13 — *But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.* Isaiah's holy seed that remains as the substance is the very seed 1 Esdras 8:70 mourns as mingled.
new: 1 Esdras 8:70 — *the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land.* Isaiah 6:13 names the same holy seed as what remains alive in the stump.

old: Ezra 9:15 — *O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.* The canon's "thou art righteous, we remain yet escaped" is exactly the root-left-this-day confession of 1 Esdras 8:89.
new: 1 Esdras 8:89 — *you are true: for we are left a root this day.* Ezra 9:15 is the same confession: he is righteous, and a remnant yet escaped.

old: Ezra 10:8 — *And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.* The forfeit of goods and casting-out for any who failed to gather is the same decree Esdras proclaims in 1 Esdras 9:4.
new: 1 Esdras 9:4 — *their cattle should be seized to the use of the temple, and himself cast out.* Ezra 10:8 records the same three-day summons and the same forfeit.

old: 1 Maccabees 1:63 — *they chose rather to die, that they might not be defiled with meats, and that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.* The substantial-faithful-unto-death-for-the-holy-covenant substance — the Maccabean-prefiguring of the substantial-King-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-as-the-Pesach-lamb-substance walks-substantively the substantial-blood-of-the-new-covenant-substance at Matt 26:28.
new: 1 Maccabees 1:63 — *that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.* The blood of the new covenant (Matthew 26:28) seals the same covenant they died for.

old: 1 Maccabees 1:63 — *Wherefore they chose rather to die, that they might not be defiled with meats, and that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.* The same choosing-to-die-rather-than-defile-the-covenant is the resolve of those who say let us die in our innocency in 1 Maccabees 2:37.
new: 1 Maccabees 1:63 — *they chose rather to die, that they might not be defiled with meats.* The same resolve as those who said let us die all in our innocency (1 Maccabees 2:37).

old: 1 Maccabees 2:41 — the Hasmonean Shabbat-defense decision; life-saving-overrides-Shabbat-restriction as the operative-principle the wisdom-stream itself had locked. Matt 12:11-12's *kal vachomer* sheep-rescue argument walks the same architecture.
new: 1 Maccabees 2:41 — *Whoever shall come to make battle with us on the sabbath day, we will fight against him.* Preserving life on the sabbath is doing well on it (Matthew 12:12).

old: 1 Maccabees 2:50 — *be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* Mattathias's deathbed-charge — the substantial-give-the-life-for-the-covenant-of-the-fathers substance. The substantial-Torah-zeal-substance walks-substantively-into the substantial-new-covenant-substance the King inaugurates at Matt 26:28 — the substantial-Torah-internalized-on-the-new-heart-substance the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) gives, NOT the inherited-Pharisaic-flesh-credential-performance-substance.
new: 1 Maccabees 2:50 — *be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* The King gave his life for that covenant; his blood of the new covenant is shed for many (Matthew 26:28).

old: 1 Maccabees 2:50 — *be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* Mattathias' charge to give their lives for the covenant; Mark 14:24's blood shed for many is the King giving his own life for the covenant the faithful died for.
new: 1 Maccabees 2:50 — *give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.* Mark 14:24, the King's blood of the new covenant shed for many, is a life given for that covenant.

old: 1 Maccabees 2:58 — *Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.* The wisdom-stream's witness to the Eliyahu-zealous-for-the-Torah architecture; Yochanan (John) at Matt 11:14 walks the same disposition at the messenger-before-the-King's-face register.
new: 1 Maccabees 2:58 — *Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.* John came in that same zeal; this is Elias which was for to come (Matthew 11:14).

old: 1 Maccabees 4:36 — *let us go up to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary.* The Hasmonean cleansing of the defiled house; John 2:16's *make not my Father's house an house of merchandise* is the same purging motion, now in the hand of the One whose house it is.
new: 1 Maccabees 4:36 — *let us go up to cleanse and dedicate the sanctuary.* The King cleansed the same house: make not my Father's house an house of merchandise (John 2:16).

old: 1 Maccabees 4:43 — *who cleansed the sanctuary, and bare out the defiled stones into an unclean place.* The wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the cleansing-of-the-sanctuary substance the King walks-out at Matt 21:12; the Maccabean-cleansing-against-the-Antiochene-outer-defilement is the architectural-parallel the King's-cleansing-against-the-Pharisaic-Sadducean-inner-corruption walks-the-same-substance of.
new: 1 Maccabees 4:43 — *cleansed the sanctuary, and bare out the defiled stones into an unclean place.* The King cast out what defiled the same house (Matthew 21:12).

old: 1 Maccabees 4:46 — *and laid up the stones in the mountain of the temple in a convenient place, until there should come a prophet to shew what should be done with them.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the prophet-yet-to-come substance the King walks-out at Matt 21:13 — the wisdom-stream-substance had-laid the substance-of-anticipation for the prophet-to-come; the multitude at v.11 names *the prophet of Natsareth (Nazareth) of Galil (Galilee)*; the King walks the substance-of-the-prophet-arrived at the temple-cleansing.
new: 1 Maccabees 4:46 — *until there should come a prophet to shew what should be done with them.* The prophet came and spoke for the house: my house shall be called the house of prayer (Matthew 21:13).

old: Exodus 23:11 — *But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.* The Torah's repeated sabbath-of-the-land is the law the few left in the sanctuary honoured though the famine scattered them in 1 Maccabees 6:54.
new: 1 Maccabees 6:54 — *There were but a few left in the sanctuary, because the famine did so prevail against them.* The famine came because they kept the seventh-year rest of Exodus 23:11.

old: Isaiah 31:1 — *Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!* The plea to Rome to take off the yoke in 1 Maccabees 8:18 is the new going-down-to-Egypt for help.
new: 1 Maccabees 8:18 — *to intreat them that they would take the yoke from them.* The embassy to Rome is the going down to Egypt for help that Isaiah 31:1 warns against.

old: Zechariah 3:10 — *In that day, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.* Zechariah binds the vine-and-fig-tree rest to the day of the BRANCH, the same shalom Simon's rule briefly foreshadows in 1 Maccabees 14:12.
new: 1 Maccabees 14:12 — *every man sat under his vine and his fig tree, and there was none to fray them.* A foretaste of the day of the BRANCH in Zechariah 3:10.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:19 — *I gave you angels' food to eat in your hunger; and when ye thirsted, I clave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Father's-wilderness-feeding-of-the-multitude architecture the King recapitulates at Matt 14:13-21 without mediation.
new: 2 Esdras 1:19 — *Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat.* The same pity fed the multitude in the desert place of Matthew 14:13.

old: 2 Esdras 1:19 — *then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels' bread.* The wilderness manna named angels' bread given out of the Father's pity; John 6:33's *the bread of Elohim (God) is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world* names the Formed one as the substance the angels' bread prefigured.
new: 2 Esdras 1:19 — *so you did eat angels’ bread.* The bread of Elohim (God) that comes down from heaven is the one the manna pointed to (John 6:33).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:30 — *I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings: but now, what shall I do to you?* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings* substance — the SAME hen-gathers-her-chickens-under-her-wings figure-of-speech the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) speaks-with-the-Father's-own-voice at Matt 23:37. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the ingathering-substance per Red Line #11 — the lament-substance walks the gathering-substance EVEN-at-the-moment-of-the-substantial-judgment of the leadership-substance the seven-woes have-walked-out.
new: 2 Esdras 1:30 — *I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings.* The King speaks the same words in the same voice over Jerusalem (Matthew 23:37).

old: 2 Esdras 1:32 — *I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).* THE direct verbal-anchor for the servants-the-prophets-taken-and-slain substance the parable walks-out at Matt 21:35 — the same architectural-substance the King will name at Matt 23:35's *the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation*; the Tanakh-pattern of prophet-killing the wisdom-stream-substance carries-forward directly.
new: 2 Esdras 1:32 — *I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain.* The husbandmen who beat, killed, and stoned the servants (Matthew 21:35) are the same story.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:32 — *I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *I sent prophets whom you have taken and slain* substance the King walks at Matt 23:34 and the prophet-killing-pattern at vv.35-36 (*all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Hevel (Abel) unto the blood of Zecharyah (Zechariah)*).
new: 2 Esdras 1:32 — *whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).* The same sender says, behold, I send unto you prophets, and some of them ye shall kill (Matthew 23:34).

old: 2 Esdras 1:33 — *thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the house-desolate substance the consequence-of-the-killing-of-the-Son at Matt 21:39 walks-into — the Olivet-discourse-substance at Matt 24:1-2 will-walk-out at the historical-pivot; the *behold, your house is left unto you desolate* at Matt 23:38 carries the same substance the wisdom-stream had-named.
new: 2 Esdras 1:33 — *Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.* The sentence falls when the husbandmen cast out the son and slay him (Matthew 21:39).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 1:33 — *Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the *Your house is desolate* substance the King names at Matt 23:38. The wisdom-stream had-named the house-left-desolate substance in continuity with Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 12:7 + 22:5 and the departure-of-the-Shekinah at Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 10:18-19 + 11:22-23. FRAMEWORK-MAJOR — the substantial-judgment of the false-shepherds is the substance that-clears-the-way for the True-Shepherd's-gathering per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34:1-31 walking-toward the surviving-third-substance of Zekharyah (Zechariah) 13:8-9.
new: 2 Esdras 1:33 — *Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate.* The King said it in the temple and walked out: your house is left unto you desolate (Matthew 23:38).

old: 2 Esdras 2:31 — *remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.* The bring-out-the-children-and-show-mercy promise; Luke 15:24's *this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found* walks the same — the scattered child gathered home with mercy.
new: 2 Esdras 2:31 — *Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth.* The son who was dead and is alive again (Luke 15:24) is that mercy in a parable.

old: 2 Esdras 2:38 — *arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God).* THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gathered-to-the-feast-of-Yahuah substance the king-substance's-servants walking-into-the-highways-and-hedges at Matt 22:9 brings-into-effect — the sealed-citizens of the kingdom gathered-from-the-scattering per Red Line #11.
new: 2 Esdras 2:38 — *behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God).* The servants sent into the highways gather them to the marriage (Matthew 22:9).

old: 2 Esdras 2:42 — *I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs.* The wisdom-stream vision of the great-people-upon-Mount-Tsion — the gathered-multitude at the Father's-feast the wedding-furnished-with-guests at Matt 22:10 walks-out; the framework reads in continuity with Revelation 7:9-17's great-multitude-from-all-nations-and-kindreds-and-tongues (the gathered-from-the-scattering substance, NOT the gathered-from-categorically-unrelated-peoples substance).
new: 2 Esdras 2:42 — *a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs.* The wedding furnished with guests (Matthew 22:10) is the same gathered crowd.

old: 2 Esdras 2:43 — *in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted.* The wisdom-stream vision of the Messianic-figure walking-among-the-gathered setting-crowns — the king-substance walking-among-the-guests at Matt 22:11 walks-out at the historical-pivot; the substance-walked-with reveals the substance-walked-without (the man-without-the-garment receives no crown).
new: 2 Esdras 2:43 — *upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted.* The king came in to see the guests and found one without a wedding garment (Matthew 22:11).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 3:21 — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wicked-heart-inherited-from-Adam architecture; preserves the actor's-responsibility (while men slept) without erasing it; the framework reads WITHOUT the Augustinian-original-sin-doctrinal-overlay.
new: 2 Esdras 3:21 — *the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome.* The field of Adam's sons is where the enemy sowed tares while men slept (Matthew 13:25).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:30 — *the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning ... until the time of threshing shall come.* THE direct wisdom-stream parallel to the wheat-and-tares architecture at the heart-of-Adam register; the time-of-threshing is the same harvest the King's parable names.
new: 2 Esdras 4:30 — *the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning.* The parable of the good seed sown in the field (Matthew 13:24) runs to the same threshing.

old: 2 Esdras 4:30-31 — *the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning... until the time of threshing come.* The way-side seed Satan takes away (Mark 4:15) and the barren soils enact the two-seeds-in-the-heart 2 Esdras names.
new: 2 Esdras 4:30 — *how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time?.* The same heart is the ground where Satan takes away the word that was sown (Mark 4:15).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:33 — *how, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?* The wisdom-stream's prophet-timing-question architecture; Yochanan (John) at Matt 11:3 walks the same legitimate-clarification-seek under the inaugurated-but-not-yet tension.
new: 2 Esdras 4:33 — *How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?.* John's question from prison (Matthew 11:3) is the same question from the same distress.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:34 — *do not you hasten above the most Highest.* The angel commends the trust-the-timeline disposition; Matt 11:6 names the blessing on the one who endures the gap without falling away.
new: 2 Esdras 4:34 — *Do not you hasten above the most Highest: for your haste is in vain to be above him.* Blessed is he who is not offended in the waiting (Matthew 11:6).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 — *the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?* The wisdom-stream's how-long-until-the-harvest question; Matt 9:37 names the answer in present-tense.
new: 2 Esdras 4:35 — *How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?.* The living are sent into the harvest the sleeping righteous wait for (Matthew 9:37).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 — *souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long?* The souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers-asking-how-long architecture; the same pattern Revelation 6:9-11 names at the souls-under-the-altar restatement; Matt 11:6 names the blessing on the disposition that endures the gap.
new: 2 Esdras 4:35 — *Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers.* The one who waits without being offended is blessed (Matthew 11:6).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 — *did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion?* The wisdom-stream's articulation of the souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers substance — the waiting-room of the righteous-dead between the first-coming and the first-resurrection; the gates-of-Sheol do not hold-the-righteous-souls-finally per the resurrection-architecture.
new: 2 Esdras 4:35 — *the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers.* The chambers hold the righteous until the resurrection; the gates of hell shall not prevail (Matthew 16:18).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:36 — *even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.* The harvest is timed to the fulness of the seed-count; Matt 9:38's prayer-for-labourers is the kingdom-citizens' participation in the seed-filling.
new: 2 Esdras 4:36 — *Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.* The labourers sent into the harvest (Matthew 9:38) are how the number is filled.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:1 — *the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.* THE direct verbal-anchor for the signs-of-the-end-of-the-age substance — the substantial-faith-substance walking-from the substantial-keep-of-the-commandments per 1 John 5:3; when the substantial-torahlessness abounds, the substantial-faith-substance fails (the substantial-direct-cause-and-effect-of-the-substantial-Matt-24:12 *because iniquity (anomia, torahlessness) shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold* substance).
new: 2 Esdras 5:1 — *the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.* The same sign: many offended, betraying and hating one another (Matthew 24:10).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:4 — *you shall see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day.* The cosmic-signs substance — the substantial-Tanakh-Day of Yahuah (the LORD) cluster the prophets-Yeshayahu (Isaiah) + Yo'el (Joel) + Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) + Amos + Mikhah (Micah) + Tsefanyah (Zephaniah) walked. The King walks the substantial *immediately after the tribulation of those days* at Matt 24:29 — the substantial-direct-rule-out of the pre-tribulation-rapture-substance.
new: 2 Esdras 5:4 — *the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day.* The signs in the heavens come after the tribulation of those days (Matthew 24:29).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:9 — *understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber, And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the understanding-withdrawing-from-the-rejecting-disposition architecture; the system-rejecting-disposition at Matt 13:13-15 encounters the withdrawn-understanding.
new: 2 Esdras 5:9 — *then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber.* To some it is given to know the mysteries; to others it is not (Matthew 13:11).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:9 — *all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber.* The substantial-internal-betrayal-substance — the substantial-pressure-of-the-substantial-tribulation generates the substantial *betray one another, and... hate one another* substance the King walks at Matt 24:10.
new: 2 Esdras 5:9 — *all friends shall destroy one another.* Many shall betray one another, and shall hate one another (Matthew 24:10).

old: 2 Esdras 5:18 — *forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.* The negative image the restoration reverses; Peter, who forsook and denied three times, is charged three times at John 21:15 onward not to be the shepherd who leaves the flock to the wolves.
new: 2 Esdras 5:18 — *forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.* Peter, who forsook three times, is charged three times to feed the flock (John 21:15).

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:23 — *O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* The Father's-singular-election-of-the-vineyard-of-Yashar'el (Israel) substance — the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 5:7's naming of the vineyard as the house of Yashar'el (Israel) the householder of Matt 20:1 hires labourers into.
new: 2 Esdras 5:23 — *of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* The householder's vineyard at Matthew 20:1 is that one chosen vine, and the labourers are hired into it.

old: 2 Esdras 5:23 — *of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine.* The one-chosen-vine architecture; the vineyard let out to husbandmen at Mark 12:1 is the one-only-vine Yashar'el (Israel), chosen out of all the trees.
new: 2 Esdras 5:23 — *you have chosen you one only vine.* The vineyard let out to husbandmen at Mark 12:1 was the owner's choice, never the keepers'.

old: 2 Esdras 5:24 — *of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily.* The one-chosen-out-of-all litany; Luke 20:16's vineyard-given-to-others is the stewardship taken from the failed husbandmen, not the chosen-vine replaced by a different people — the one Yashar'el (Israel) remains, the keeping changes hands.
new: 2 Esdras 5:24 — *of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit.* At Luke 20:16 the keeping passes to others; the chosen vine stays the Most High's own.

old: 2 Esdras 5:27 — *among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law.* The one-chosen-people-given-the-law; Mark 12:9's *the lord of the vineyard ... will give the vineyard unto others* turns on the same election — the vineyard belongs to the lord who chose it, the keeping passes from the keepers who failed.
new: 2 Esdras 5:27 — *among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people.* The lord of the vineyard at Mark 12:9 takes back the keeping of a people that was always his.

old: 2 Esdras 5:27 — *among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.* The one-people-given-the-law substance; the vine is the one beloved people Yashar'el (Israel) given the Torah, let out to the husbandmen who void the law while holding the vine.
new: 2 Esdras 5:27 — *to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.* The vineyard let out at Luke 20:9 is this people, and the fruit sought is the law kept.

old: 2 Esdras 5:29 — *they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.* The covenant-trodden-down lament; the wicked husbandmen who slay the servants and the heir are the keepers who gainsaid the promises, and the lord's judgment at Mark 12:9 answers the 2 Esdras lament.
new: 2 Esdras 5:29 — *they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.* The husbandmen of Mark 12:9 carry the same unbelief inside the hedge, and meet the same owner.

old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* John's opened books before the throne are the very 'books opened before the firmament' of 2 Esdras 6:20 — the self-link of the live Revelation apparatus.
new: 2 Esdras 6:20 — *the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together.* John sees the same books opened before the throne at Revelation 20:12.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 6:26 — *the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the truth-revealed-after-long-hiddenness; the latter-days substance the King's parables-method enacts in operative-form.
new: 2 Esdras 6:26 — *the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.* The parables of Matthew 13:35 open what was kept secret to a heart turned toward their meaning.

old: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:28 — *for my son the Messiah shall be revealed.* (Seeded text's "Yahusha (Jesus)" naming at this verse is corrected by this migration to the underlying Syriac's *the Messiah*.) The wisdom-stream's apocalyptic-register confirmation of the Davidic-Messianic figure Matt 9:27's blind men confess.

new: Baruch 3:30 — *Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold.* Wisdom past man's reach; the Son of Adam came down from where she dwells (John 3:13).

new: Baruch 3:36 — *has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.* Wisdom's children at Matthew 11:19 are the people she was given to.

old: Baruch 3:37 — *Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.* The Hebrew library names the descent that answered the wisdom-search; this is the substance of John 3:13's Son of Adam who *came down from heaven* — the wisdom no man could fetch down now standing in flesh.
new: Baruch 3:37 — *Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.* The descent John 3:13 names: the Son of Adam who came down from heaven.

new: Baruch 4:1 — *This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever.* Near and keepable, as Deuteronomy 30:14 says of the same word.

old: Isaiah 66:13 — *As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.* The joy-from-the-Holy-One of Baruch 4:22 is Yahuah's mother-comfort poured out in Jerusalem.

new: Baruch 4:36 — *look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).* The gathering that keeps the oath to Abraham and his seed for ever (Luke 1:55).

new: Baruch 4:36 — *behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).* Isaiah's lift up thine eyes upon the gathering children (Isaiah 49:18).

new: Baruch 4:37 — *your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west.* Abraham's seed for ever, gathered home (Luke 1:55).

old: Baruch 4:37 — *your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.* The scattered children gathered home; John 11:52's *gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad* walks the same.
new: Baruch 4:37 — *they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One.* The scattered children of Elohim (God) gathered into one (John 11:52).

new: Baruch 5:5 — *behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One.* With 4:37 the gathering comes from every direction; the elect from the four winds (Mark 13:27).

new: Baruch 5:5 — *Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east.* Jerusalem's own children brought home as children of the kingdom; they come from east and west to sit down in it (Luke 13:29).

old: Baruch 5:5 — *behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One.* The gathering-of-the-children doubled with Baruch 4:37; John 11:52's scattered children gathered into one walks the same Hebrew library homecoming.
new: Baruch 5:5 — *your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One.* The scattered children gathered into one (John 11:52).

new: Baruch 5:7 — *every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up.* The leveled road is for Yashar'el (Israel) to walk home; John opened it (Luke 3:5).

old: Baruch 5:9 — *Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory.* Where the gathering-road arrives; Luke 3:6's *all flesh shall see the salvation of Elohim (God)* names the salvation seen at the end of the leveled highway.
new: Baruch 5:9 — *Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory.* Where the road ends; all flesh sees the salvation of Elohim (God) (Luke 3:6).

old: Baruch 5:9 — *Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory.* The leading-home of Yashar'el (Israel); John 11:52's gathering of the scattered children into one is the gospel-form of the same homecoming.
new: Baruch 5:9 — *with the mercy and righteousness that comes from him.* Yashar'el (Israel) led home with joy is the scattered children gathered into one (John 11:52).

old: Deuteronomy 4:28 — *And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.* Moses named the work-of-men's-hands curse of exile that Baruch 6:51 watches play out among the Babylonian gods.
new: Baruch 6:51 — *they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands.* The exile curse Moses named in Deuteronomy 4:28, watched from inside Babylon.

new: Ecclesiasticus 1:28 — *come not to him with a double heart.* The second son's *I go, sir: and went not* (Matthew 21:30).

old: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 1:28 — *Distrust not the fear of Yahuah (God) when you are poor: and come not to him with a double heart.* The wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the come-not-with-a-double-heart substance — the same substance the King walks-against at Matt 23:25 (the outside-of-the-cup against the inside-full-of-extortion-and-excess).
new: Ecclesiasticus 1:28 — *come not to him with a double heart.* The clean cup with the foul inside at Matthew 23:25.

new: Ecclesiasticus 1:29 — *Be not an hypocrite in the sight of men.* The second son's public yes and absent obedience at Matthew 21:30.

new: Ecclesiasticus 1:29 — *Be not an hypocrite in the sight of men.* Righteousness outward unto men, hypocrisy within, at Matthew 23:28.

new: Ecclesiasticus 1:29 — *Be not an hypocrite in the sight of men, and take good heed what you speak.* The Messiah's woe at Matthew 23:28 indicts exactly this man.

new: Ecclesiasticus 2:1 — *if you come to serve Yahuah (God), prepare your soul for temptation.* The endurance to the end Yahusha (Jesus) asks of the twelve at Matthew 10:22.

new: Ecclesiasticus 2:5 — *gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity.* The furnace the twelve are sent into at Matthew 10:22.

new: Ecclesiasticus 3:1 — *Hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter.* The children who come when called, of whom the kingdom is, at Matthew 19:14.

old: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:18 — *the greater you are, the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God).* The greater-the-more-humble wisdom-instruction — the inverse-architecture the King names at Matt 20:26-27's *whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister.* The kingdom-citizens'-greatness flows-up-as-service, the categorical-inverse of the natural-kingdoms'-greatness-flowing-down-as-domination under-the-watcher-rebellion-administration (Daniel 10:13, 20; Ephesians 6:12; 1 John 5:19).
new: Ecclesiasticus 3:18 — *the more humble thyself, and you shall find favour before Yahuah (God).* Greatness as service, against the domination of the princes, at Matthew 20:26.

new: Ecclesiasticus 3:19 — *mysteries are revealed to the meek.* Hid from the wise and prudent, revealed unto babes (Matthew 11:25).

new: Ecclesiasticus 6:1 — *Instead of a friend become not an enemy.* Judas's *Master, is it I?* at Matthew 26:25 with the bargain already made.
